statement: AMD guided Q3 2026 revenue to approximately $13.0 billion plus or minus $300 million, about 41% year-over-year growth, with non-GAAP gross margin around 56%.
why: Forward guidance above the just-reported quarter tells the desk the vendor expects order flow to keep building rather than plateau.

impact.mechanism: Sequential revenue guidance implies committed customer orders and secured supply for the coming quarter, a leading read on accelerator demand.

evidence.excerpt: Q3 2026 guidance: revenue of approximately $13.0 billion, plus or minus $300 million, representing about 41% YoY growth; non-GAAP gross margin guided at approximately 56%.

confidence.basis: Company's own guidance stated in its quarterly results press release, a primary source.

dispersion: Guidance band of plus or minus $300 million around $13.0 billion.
